classification.summary: AccountLiquidator.liquidateUser() accepted an arbitrary caller-supplied HouseOfReserve, so a fake reserve that reused the real accounting token ids while reporting a price that rounded the liquidation cost to zero moved victims' collateral records to the attacker, who then withdrew the real cbETH and WETH.

sources.note: onchain review: AccountLiquidator proxy 0x4b75Fb5B0D323672fc6Eac5Afbf487AE4c2ff6de created 2024-06-09T19:57:59Z by 0x3ae24b06715729ea45208d3c5ef581b260c427bc, not the attack-tx sender 0xdb731450e065ea7f6bef6d27e88dd07d6e2d1af5; a single EIP-1967 Upgraded event at deployment installs implementation 0xeab948ec7ce3f403b63787ba3884aaf43d07ca9c (the address the PoC header names), so the executing code was 653.1 days old. 3.25 cbETH plus 0.22 WETH is 3.47 ETH-equivalent x $2,143.94 at the incident timestamp (DefiLlama) = $7,439.
